title: Customer Lifetime Value & CAC Payback Calculator

listing.description_html:
For each marketing channel: what a customer costs to win, what they are worth in gross profit, the value-to-cost ratio, and how many months it takes to earn the cost back.

This workbook works it out per channel: the customer acquisition cost (spend divided by new customers), the customer's lifetime value in gross profit (not revenue), the ratio between the two, and the payback period, the months of gross profit it takes to earn back what the customer cost.

What's included

  • Customer acquisition cost per marketing channel
  • Lifetime value in gross profit, not revenue
  • Value-to-cost ratio and payback months per channel
  • GROW / WATCH / CUT verdict against the targets you set
  • Blended summary with best and worst channel
  • PDF guide with a worked example and a field-by-field reference

Who it's for

  • Online shops and DTC brands running paid ads
  • Service businesses using referrals, ads and directories
  • Subscription and membership businesses
  • Founders preparing a growth plan or investor update

You get: customer_lifetime_value_cac_calculator.xlsx (Settings, Channels, Summary) and this guide.

Works in Excel 2016 or later, Excel for Mac and Excel on the web; opens in Google Sheets and LibreOffice.

This workbook is a planning tool, not financial advice. Lifetime value is an estimate built from the averages you enter; check it against real repeat-purchase data as it accumulates.
